Two benchmarks

Why the lower score carries more evidence.

The project retained a legacy benchmark for sensitivity analysis, then separated it from the leakage-resistant research result.

Profile-isolated evaluation 74.2%

Exact duplicates removed; identical predictor profiles kept in one split or fold. This is the reported research estimate.

versus
Legacy row split 90.1%

79.8% of test rows had a predictor profile also present in training. Useful as an audit, not as clinical or external validation.

Interpretation boundary

These results establish an internal, reproducible proof of concept. They do not establish safety, clinical utility, external validity, or performance for child and neonatal outcomes.

Explainable AI for Maternal and Child Health OutcomesAdesanmi Anuoluwapo Gideon · Federal University Oye-Ekiti ·

Research prototype for maternal-risk classification. Child and neonatal outcomes are outside the dataset and implementation scope.
